adaptive_context: This sequential experiment was designed after the completed residual-preservation OOF test showed that uncertainty penalties were not rank-calibrated and that residual predictions had negligible complementarity with the E5 joint-value baseline. It is exploratory rather than a pristine independent confirmation.
fixed_representation: intfloat/e5-base-v2 full first-step text plus train-only attack-family, injection-task, and family-by-injection structured fields

fixed_pair_schemes.largest_gap_control: The existing E5 control: up to 64 largest target-gap pairs per training task.
fixed_pair_schemes.top_anchor: Only oracle-top-tier versus lower-tier pairs are retained, up to 64 per training task.
fixed_pair_schemes.lambda_ndcg3: Pairs are weighted by the ideal-list NDCG@3 loss caused by swapping them; weights are normalized within each training task.

comparisons: formal frozen Dreamer OOF pct100 Top-1
frozen E5 plus structured largest-gap pairwise ridge
claim_boundary: No scheme may replace the fixed lambda_ndcg3 primary after test inspection. The two other schemes are reported as counterevidence, and all claims remain sequentially exploratory.
